name: mark, tagline and a single CTA close
looks: A mark and wordmark settle above centre on a warm, softly gradient field. A short tagline fades in beneath them, one word in the accent colour, and a bright rounded call-to-action button settles underneath it last.
build: Mark/wordmark fade/scale in together (0.92 -> 1, power3.out); the tagline fades/rises in after a short pause; the CTA button scales in last (back.out) and holds for at least 1s.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the mark lands, the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Settle a mark and wordmark above centre on a warm gradient field, fade in a short tagline beneath them with one word in the accent colour, then settle a bright call-to-action button underneath that, holding the finished card as the close.
